note: Every rate here is shown in the tools with its source and date. Secondary sources were used where the official notification could not be fetched; each is marked for a check against the official portal before launch.

UP.label: Uttar Pradesh (Noida, Greater Noida)
UP.summary: Stamp duty 7%. Women get 1 point off (6%) on homes up to ₹1 crore; joint male and female 6.5%. Registration 1%.

sources.title: UP Govt extends stamp duty concession for women on property worth up to ₹1 crore (Free Press Journal)
Stamp Duty and Registration Charges in Uttar Pradesh 2026 (Godrej Capital)

DL.label: Delhi
DL.summary: Stamp duty 6% (men), 4% (women), 5% (joint). Registration 1% plus ₹100 pasting fee. NDMC and Cantonment areas differ.

sources.title: Stamp Duty & Registration Charges in Delhi 2026 (ClearTax)
Stamp Duty and Property Registration Charges in Delhi (BankBazaar)

UK.label: Uttarakhand (Kainchi Dham, Nainital district)
UK.summary: Stamp duty 5%. Women 3.75% on property up to ₹25 lakh. Registration 2%; sources disagree on the cap (₹25,000 or ₹50,000), so the tool uses the higher one.

sources.title: Stamp duty and registration charges in Uttarakhand (Square Yards)
Stamp duty registration charges in Uttarakhand (HomeFirst)

gst.commercialNote: Most sources give 12% with input tax credit for under-construction shops and offices; at least two say 18% after the September 2025 GST changes. Ask the developer for the rate on its tax invoice.

sources.title: GST on under construction property, rates and calculation (HomeFirst)

loan.ltvSummary: RBI caps on loan to value: up to 90% for loans up to ₹30 lakh, 80% up to ₹75 lakh, 75% above that.

ltvSources.title: Home buyers can now get more loan for property up to Rs 30 lakh (Business Standard, 2015)
Home loan LTV ratio calculation (HDFC Bank)

loan.foirNote: Our assumption, not a bank rule: many lenders let total EMIs reach roughly 40 to 60% of take-home pay. Your bank decides.
loan.rateNote: Example rate only. Use the rate on your bank's sanction letter.
